name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Péter Magyar
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided not to lift the legal protection (immunity) of Péter Magyar, a Hungarian member of the European Parliament. A Hungarian court asked for this protection to be removed so he could face a criminal case over calling a political rival a "common criminal" at a public event in August 2024. Parliament judged that the case looks like an attempt to harm his political work rather than to repair real reputational damage.

- Péter Magyar keeps his immunity, so the Hungarian criminal case cannot go ahead for now.
- It affects Magyar, his party, and the politician who brought the private complaint against him.
- Parliament's President will send the decision to the Hungarian court and to Magyar.
